title: CAI Content Credentials is affected by an Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability that could…
description: CAI Content Credentials suffers from an improper verification of cryptographic signatures vulnerability that could allow an attacker to bypass security features and gain unauthorized write access. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as visiting a malicious URL or interacting with a compromised web page. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.5.
